question: Find the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are represented by $2\hat{i}+\hat{j}$ and $\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$.
explanation:
Step 1: Vector product of adjacent sides
Let $\vec{a}=2\hat{i}+\hat{j}$ and $\vec{b}=\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$. Then
\(\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=\begin{vmatrix}\hat{i}&\hat{j}&\hat{k}\\2&1&0\\1&-1&2\end{vmatrix}\)
Step 2: Expansion of the determinant
\(\vec{a}\times\vec{b}=2\hat{i}-4\hat{j}-3\hat{k}\)
Step 3: Magnitude of the vector product
\(|\vec{a}\times\vec{b}|=\sqrt{2^2+(-4)^2+(-3)^2}=\sqrt{29}\)
Step 4: Geometrical interpretation
The magnitude of the cross product equals the area of the parallelogram formed by the two adjacent sides.
Final Answer
The area is $\sqrt{29}$ square units.
